# ISDOC 6.0.1 XSD (vendored, third-party)

- **Source:** https://isdoc.cz/6.0.1/xsd/isdoc-invoice-6.0.1.xsd
- **Downloaded:** 2026-07-31
- **Version:** 6.0.1
- **Copyright:** (c) 2010-2014 ICT UNIE o.s. / SPIS (see the file's own header comment
  for the license text — redistribution for validation purposes is explicitly
  permitted).

This is the **official schema**, used only to validate the ISDOC XML produced by
`Modules\Accounting\Support\IsdocFormat` (see
`tests/Feature/Modules/Accounting/IsdocSchemaTest.php`).

**Do not edit this file.** If the ISDOC standard publishes a newer version, vendor
the new file under a new filename (`isdoc-invoice-6.0.2.xsd`, etc.) rather than
modifying this one in place, so the version on disk always matches its own
declared `version` attribute.
